title: P6: a dispatched-but-silent reviewer must fail closed (timeout -> one retry -> STOP), not pass silently
objective: QUALIFYING EVIDENCE (AD-093 unresolved crash/recovery problem + observed session-14 behaviour): M0-T036-ACTIVATION-CHECKLIST P6. Across session 14 FOUR independently-dispatched reviewers went idle having completed analysis without delivering; each verdict was recovered only because a human-paced orchestrator noticed and re-dispatched, and two then returned REQUIRED corrections (the missing reports were load-bearing). Unattended this is 'absent evidence treated as passing evidence' (the d45f330 failure mode). SCOPE (deterministic, additive; does NOT touch the acceptance gate which already fails closed on a missing PASS): the supervisor's reviewer-gate handling must treat 'gate dispatched, no verdict returned' as bounded-timeout detection -> ONE controlled retry/re-dispatch -> then a hard fail-closed PAUSE/STOP with a recorded reason and visible evidence. A dispatched-but-silent reviewer must never be indistinguishable from a clean review; no timeout may downgrade to 'proceed'. REQUIRED TESTS: a silent reviewer triggers exactly one re-dispatch then STOPS with the recorded reason; a reviewer that returns on retry proceeds normally; a returned FAIL/BLOCKED is unaffected; full supervisor suite re-establishes the M0-T039 baseline (>=1165, 0 failures) plus the new tests.
business_reason: P6 is a required pre-M0-T056 deterministic correction: under unattended actuation a silent reviewer must block, not pass; it is additive to (not a duplicate of) project_control.accept which already fail-closes on a missing PASS record.
forbidden_paths: tools/agent_supervisor/** modules not named in allowed_paths (smallest durable set only; wider need = STOP-and-report at G0)
Any redesign or speculative supervisor feature (supervisor-freeze; defect-only)
acceptance_scenarios: P6-SC1 a dispatched reviewer that returns nothing triggers EXACTLY ONE controlled re-dispatch, then a hard fail-closed PAUSE/STOP with a recorded reason and visible evidence.
P6-SC2 a reviewer that returns on the retry proceeds normally (no false stop).
P6-SC3 a returned FAIL/BLOCKED verdict is unaffected (P6 only handles SILENCE, not delivered verdicts).
P6-SC4 no timeout downgrades to 'proceed'; a silent reviewer is never indistinguishable from a clean review.
P6-SC5 freeze baseline: full supervisor suite re-establishes M0-T039 (>=1165, 0 failures) + new tests; non-vacuity shown.
risks: PRODUCER MUST CONFIRM EXACT FILES AT G0: reviewer-gate dispatch/timeout handling is spread across review_cadence.py / ephemeral_review.py / codex_reviewer.py / loop.py; find where a reviewer verdict is awaited and narrow to the smallest set that adds the timeout->retry->STOP. STOP-and-report if a different file is required.
Additive to (NOT a duplicate of) project_control.accept, which already fail-closes on a missing PASS record — P6 is the supervisor's OWN reviewer-gate posture under unattended actuation.
Independent of P1/P2/P3 file scope (different modules) — MAY be built in parallel with them IF the confirmed file set stays disjoint from claude_runner.py/recovery.py/loop.py.
Supervisor-freeze: re-establish the M0-T039 baseline under G0/G2/G3/G5.
